evidence.label: thread report
evidence.shows: Too few extreme replies to compare (0; the report needs 10). 10 replies are left out until the accounts are looked up.
evidence.source: The posts in the input, as given, read by Daylight Commons on this device. Account details given in the input: what each platform discloses on profiles and About pages.
evidence.context: A skew compares the thread as a whole, separate from any one reply or account. It can come from how the platform ranks replies, from which accounts were looked up, or from real people who joined during the event.

evidence.label: near-identical replies, 5 accounts
evidence.shows: 5 replies from 5 different accounts share most of their wording (similarity at least 0.82). In ordinary threads with 5 to 19 replies, a group of near-identical replies from different accounts showed up in 0.5% of threads (95% interval 0.3 to 0.8%, 3,087 threads).
evidence.source: The posts in the input, as given, read by Daylight Commons on this device.
evidence.context: Other accounts posted identical replies. That shows copying or coordination, and people also share text they agree with.
